name: Semi-permeable capsule (SPC) workflow on resin_print_multilayer
description: Generated by autochip from 'Semi-permeable capsule (SPC) workflow'. Four chips. Chip 1 (37 C) covers cell rinse, dissociation, quench, wash, core mixing and droplet formation. Chip 2 is cold (4 C) for gelation, then oil removal, curing and capsule wash. Chip 3 takes the capsule filter plus lysis, RT and washes. The split from the previous plan fixes the size error: the filter moved off the cold chip. Index PCR reaches 95 C, above the 50 C limit of the printed resin, so the split (20) and the index PCR (21) are done off chip in tubes on the thermocycler. The portions are pooled by pipette and returned to chip 4, which digests the shells and does the magnetic bead cleanup. Chip 4 has no thermocycler, so the magnet is the only equipment there. Culture (1), counting (8) and measurement (26) stay on the bench. The 40 um cell strainer (7) has no usable part, because the pillar filter cannot go below 100 um.

modules.name: Cell rinse, dissociation, quench, wash and encapsulation chip
modules.note: Rinses and detaches the cells, quenches the enzyme, washes the cells in a spiral, mixes in core solution and forms ~70 um droplets at the flow-focusing junction.

modules.name: Gelation, emulsion breaking, curing and capsule wash chip
modules.note: Gels the shells in a cold delay line, then breaks the emulsion, photocures and washes the capsules in a trap.

modules.name: Capsule filter, lysis, reverse transcription and wash chip
modules.note: Removes aggregates from the capsules, then lyses the cells, washes, reverse transcribes and washes again in a trap.

modules.name: Shell release, bead capture, ethanol wash and elution chip
modules.note: Digests the capsule shells to release cDNA, then binds the library to magnetic beads, washes them with ethanol on the magnet and elutes in water.

handoffs.note: capsules by off chip step, through bench step(s) 20, 21

roadmap.name: Bench: step 26
roadmap.note: Measure library concentration and fragment size.
